int.split.mark: aria-label of a split marker in the valleys; {rt} = time of the vertical line in minutes, 3 decimals.
int.base.clamped: Line of the box on the "A = …" label when the baseline of an integration, extended past its two points, would have gone below zero and is held at 0; {v} = area not counted below zero (counts·s).
int.split.hand.mark: aria-label of a marker of the split by hand; {rt} = time of the vertical line in minutes, 3 decimals.
int.base.tip: Line of the box on the "A = …" label of an integration: the baseline used; {b} = name of the mode (int.base.tag.*).
int.follow.sn: Box on the label of a window that follows the sample (SIM/MRM): signal-to-noise ratio measured by the engine; {sn} = number, "…" while waiting, "—" without a peak.
canali.manint.cp.aria: Accessible name of a copyable cell (apex, area, height) of the "Manual integrations" table; {c} = column header, {v} = value shown.
int.follow.note: Box on the label of a window applied from another sample: where it comes from and that drawing one on this sample overrides it; {f} = name of the sample where it was drawn.
int.anchor.a: Tooltip (title and aria-label) of the first anchor point of a SIM/MRM integration; {rt} = time in minutes, {y} = intensity, {m} = anchoring mode (Follow the curve, At zero, Manual).
int.anchor.b: Like int.anchor.a, for the second anchor point.
canali.manint.title: Title of the manual integrations card in Data; {n} = number of integrated windows.
canali.manint.show.aria: Label of the button that shows the chart of an integration; {ch} = channel (m/z or transition), {s} = sample.
canali.manint.del.aria: Label of the button that deletes an integration; {ch} = channel (m/z or transition), {s} = sample.
canali.sim.ion: Name of a SIM channel whose m/z the file does not give; {n} = position of the channel (1, 2, …).
canali.sim.cell: "Experiment" cell of the file table for a SIM file; {n} = number of monitored ions.
canali.btn.aria: Accessible name of the channels button; {n} = number of traced channels.
canali.pick.ck: Tooltip on hovering the checkbox of a row of the transition / SIM ion picker; {et} = channel label (m/z).
canali.row: Description read by a screen reader of a row of the channel tree; {et} = channel label, {n} = number of points (scans), {a} and {b} = start and end time in minutes.
canali.kind.aria: Accessible name of the button that chooses what the chromatogram traces; {v} = button text (for example TIC or TIC + 1).
canali.manint.nopeak.tip: Tooltip (max 60 characters) on the area and height of a row with no peak found: they are those of the window left where it was, not a result.
canali.manint.applied: Announcement (aria-live) after a drawn integration has been applied to other samples; {n} = number of samples that have an applied row.
int.follow.org.applied: Line of the tooltip of an integration applied to another sample: the peak is inside the window; {f} = source sample, {d} = shift (not used here).
int.follow.org.shifted: Tooltip: the window was moved to follow the peak (retention time drift); {d} = shift in minutes, already formatted; {f} = source sample.
int.follow.org.nopeak: Tooltip: no peak in this sample, the window of the source sample {f} stays; {d} not used.
int.follow.org.manual: Tooltip of a window drawn by hand on this sample (not applied from another one).
